0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFACHIEVEMENTREWARD_00107_JONATHAS_000_001
0.description: Hello there, young one. How very kind of you to offer a dodderin' old man like me a bit of company. Tell me, do you like tales? I do like a good tale, 'specially true ones told by them as lived it. If you have any of your own to share, I'd be all ears.

1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFACHIEVEMENTREWARD_00107_TERREMIAUX_Q1_01
1.description: What would you like to do?

6.name: TEXT_CMNDEFACHIEVEMENTREWARD_00107_JONATHAS_000_010
6.description: When I was a young man, I had the honor of working as a court scribe. Aye, in the good old days when my eyes were keen and the royal family still held true power in Ul'dah.

7.name: TEXT_CMNDEFACHIEVEMENTREWARD_00107_JONATHAS_000_011
7.description: Not a day seemed to go by that the royal palace didn't burst into a rainbow of colors with lavish functions and opulent feasts. Nowadays, though, it's true tales of adventure and derring-do that delight me most.

8.name: TEXT_CMNDEFACHIEVEMENTREWARD_00107_JONATHAS_000_012
8.description: If you've done any deeds you're proud of, I'd like it very much if you shared them with me. Might be as I'll even give you a little something in return.

9.name: TEXT_CMNDEFACHIEVEMENTREWARD_00107_SYSTEM_000_013
9.description: Completing certain achievements will earn you a reward, which can be collected by speaking with Jonathas.

10.name: TEXT_CMNDEFACHIEVEMENTREWARD_00107_SYSTEM_010_031
10.description: Every achievement completed grants achievement points, and accumulating a certain amount will earn you an achievement certificate.

11.name: TEXT_CMNDEFACHIEVEMENTREWARD_00107_JONATHAS_000_030
11.description: You've accomplished enough feats to keep the bards singing for a lifetime, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>. Such an achievement shouldn't go unrecognized, and to that end I'd like you to have this. Consider it a token of my highest esteem.

12.name: TEXT_CMNDEFACHIEVEMENTREWARD_00107_SYSTEM_000_031
12.description: Your accrued achievement points have earned you an achievement certificate.

13.name: TEXT_CMNDEFACHIEVEMENTREWARD_00107_SYSTEM_000_032
13.description: Certificates may be exchanged for a special reward of your choice by speaking with Jonathas.

24.name: TEXT_CMNDEFACHIEVEMENTREWARD_00107_SYSTEM_000_041
24.description: Rewards may also be redeemed directly from the Achievements menu under Character of the main menu.
